label: Netlify
agentGuide: Base path /api/v1. Me: GET /api/v1/user; sites: GET /api/v1/sites (id, name, url, published_deploy.published_at); one: GET /api/v1/sites/<id>. Deploys: GET /api/v1/sites/<id>/deploys?per_page=10 (id, state, branch, title, deploy_ssl_url); one: GET /api/v1/deploys/<id>; its log: GET /api/v1/deploys/<id>/log. Trigger a build: POST /api/v1/sites/<id>/builds {}. Roll back: POST /api/v1/sites/<id>/deploys/<id>/restore. Environment: GET /api/v1/accounts/<account>/env?site_id=<id>. Forms: GET /api/v1/sites/<id>/forms, submissions: GET /api/v1/forms/<id>/submissions. DNS zones: GET /api/v1/dns_zones. The token is set by Allkin.
